SwitchPreference.android:title: Start at Boot
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Automatically run DFRoot on device boot

SwitchPreference.android:title: Auto Soft Reboot
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Applies to both Manual Start and Start at Boot.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Restart adbd as root
SwitchPreference.android:summary: After a successful run, restart adbd so that 'adb shell' runs as uid 0. This drops the current adb session.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Disable KSU Modules
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Turn this on if a broken module is crashing your device. The next run will launch with all modules disabled.
